name: Hajimete no Orusuban
original_name: はじめてのおるすばん
source:
Shiori and Saori are twins, and they have a secret crush on the "oniichan" that lives next door. Recently they developed an interest in H. "I'll have "oniichan" teach me various things." 

When summer comes he is asked to look after the house and the girls by their mother. Since it is summer vacation, there is a lot of free time. How fun can house sitting become?

[Quoted (and translated) from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=201961]Getchu[/url] and from a [url=http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=4131]forum post[/url] by Baldo]
translation:
詩織和沙織是雙胞胎，她們暗戀著住在隔壁的「大哥哥」。最近他們對H產生了興趣。「我會讓『大哥哥』教我各種東西。」 

當夏天到來時，她們的媽媽拜託他幫忙看家，順便照顧兩個女兒。由於是暑假，所以有很多空閒時間。看家能有多好玩呢？

[引用（並翻譯）自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=201961]Getchu[/url]和Baldo的 [url=http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=4131]討論區文章[/url]]
